notes: The T2 checks (1..37) all ran BEFORE the world-changing «осмотреться» probe, so the no-event / no-time evidence is not polluted by it.
«осмотреться» is world-changing by contract: it moved the scratch world to worldTime=1 and added the only chronicle turn.
A speech turn is NOT a pure conversation turn: it commits Domain Events and advances time. Only inquiry / meta / clarification are read-side.
The idempotency key travels in the request body field idempotencyKey; the Idempotency-Key header is used only for world creation.
The scratch world stays in the catalog (there is no delete endpoint); it is labelled T2Check.
